program.label: 在线工程 F · 已揭示预测与执行偏差

diagnosis_rules.condition: (forecast_bias_load_samples >= 8 and forecast_bias_load_ratio >= 0.1 and forecast_bias_load_agreement >= 0.75) or (forecast_bias_pv_samples >= 8 and forecast_bias_pv_ratio >= 0.1 and forecast_bias_pv_agreement >= 0.75 and (forecast_bias_pv_mw >= 0.005 or forecast_bias_pv_mw <= -0.005))
